workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.selectHint: Select or add a workspace to open a terminal.

team.title: Team
team.requestLabel: Describe the task and the team
team.requestPlaceholder: E.g.: 2 agents — one for the API, one for tests
team.untrusted: Claude Code does not trust this folder yet, so the agents would stop at the trust prompt.
team.untrustedHint: Open a terminal in the folder, run claude, choose "Yes, I trust this folder" and exit. Then click Check again.
team.verifyNote: Approving lets INA run these commands in each agent's worktree.

integration.title: Integration

confirm.integrate: Merge the agents' branches into the workspace's current branch?
confirm.cleanup: Stop the team's terminals and remove the worktrees and already merged branches?
confirm.forceCleanup: Delete the UNTRACKED files of the worktrees that failed? Only merged branches with no modified tracked files are removed. This cannot be undone.

integration.conflict: conflict in {{files}}; merge aborted, nothing changed

preview.title: Preview (nothing was changed):
preview.conflict: predicted conflict in {{files}}; integration would stop here
preview.notReached: would not be attempted (stops at the conflict)
preview.overlap: {{file}} was changed by {{agents}}: review how they combine
preview.unavailable: Preview unavailable ({{error}}). You can still integrate.

setup.title: Claude Code is not ready yet
setup.notInstalled: Claude Code not found on PATH. Install it with: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
setup.notOnboarded: First run pending: open a terminal, run claude and finish the initial setup.
setup.notLoggedIn: Not logged in: run claude in a terminal and log in (or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).

messages.title: Messages
messages.notifyHint: Types one fixed line into the agent's terminal asking it to read .ina/inbox/. Use it when the agent is not showing a permission prompt.
messages.notOpen: The agent's terminal is not open; the message waits in its inbox.
